name: subscribe__keepalive_deterministic
description: Deterministic counterpart to subscribe__max_interval_keepalive: instead of waiting for the heartbeat to fire by wall-clock, the harness drives the engine via engine_tick_at to a synthetic clock 2000 ms past subscription admission. With MaxIntervalCeiling=2 the matter.js-aligned sendInterval formula produces a 1.6 s heartbeat (max(MinIntervalFloor, maxInterval × 0.8)); the engine then ships an empty-payload ReportData. Locks the same heartbeat cadence as Phase P but in <50 ms of test time, demonstrating the clock-injection seam.
